title: 第568章 精灵匪帮第567章 奥伦提尔王国
content_zh:
几乎所有的种族在听到精灵的印象，往往都是什么长寿、英俊、美丽、干净、有礼之类的，人们往往只看到了精灵们好的一面，艾什看到的则不止这些。
繁琐的规矩与教条、做作又虚伪，傲慢且自负，他们秉持着虚无的高雅，却有时做的事不如地精的密谋，病态的崇尚自然却破坏它们，沉迷与自我感觉文明，从此被桎梏。
至少艾什遇到的大多数精灵，给她的印象全是这样，最开始旅行时的森林精灵兄妹，阿莱克耐心野鹿搜找营的精灵们，木精灵和其他精灵，外加上暗精灵河匪......
艾什已经不期待见到真正善良，高雅又能够被称得上精灵美德的精灵了，哪怕是坐在身边的伊拉，大口往嘴里灌苹果汁的样子被其他高精灵旅客所鄙夷。
谁能想到精灵内部之间还有歧视呢？高精灵自诩文明悠久，是所有精灵的“起源之一”，就很理所当然的瞧不起森林精灵、沼泽精灵、木精灵、暗精灵，以及其他许许多多的精灵。
艾什撑着下巴撇嘴，对其他高精灵旅客感到虚伪，不屑地把玩自己的银发，侧脸去看旅馆柜台上的悬赏与告示。
用高精灵古老精灵语、精灵语和西大路通用语写的三种语言文字，就好像高精灵们在炫耀学识一般。
在洛瑞安能找到一个旅馆住很困难，驾马车在城里转了好几圈，在找到一家能够停放马车并看管的旅馆，其余的旅馆不是没有地方停马车就是不愿保护马车，或者根本不会喂养马匹。
好在这家叫做“绿木树根”的旅馆能做到这些，店主是一对高精灵老夫妇，这倒是很稀奇。
能活到脸上布满皱纹，已驼了背的岁数，艾什都不敢想柜台后神采奕奕，完全没有老人浑浊眼神的高精灵老夫妻.......今年能有多少岁了。
他们的两个儿子，一个孙子和孙女维持着这座“家庭旅馆”，也算是家族产业了吧，大儿子在厨房为艾什几人做早餐，二儿子则在后院擦拭几人的马车，接下来还要保养马匹。
看起来二十几岁的孙子和孙女穿梭在旅馆大厅，为旅客们端上食物和酒水，他们脸上的笑意不像是装出来的，给人一种亲切和自然的感觉。
礼仪上他们也不差，说话慢条斯理，吐字清晰，在听到艾什点了一大堆肉食后，也没有像伊拉那样嫌弃，很开心地去为艾什准备，艾什认为是自己在桌面上拍了三枚金币的缘故吧......
巴尼他们大声说笑，引起周围高精灵旅客的不满，就算他们歧视其他种族，也不敢找麻烦的，芙涅娅的法杖就在身边，卡森一看就不像是好欺负的人，博里克打着酒嗝儿笑的更欢，他好像在故意无礼的一样。
一定是博里克看到了高精灵们盯着伊拉而露出轻蔑的神情，老混蛋心有不满，在暗中激怒高精灵，可问题在于伊拉根本没发现自己被歧视了，正吃着精灵沙拉开心地快要哼歌了。
“还是同族做的沙拉好吃呀！我有些想念妈妈做的沙拉了！小番茄和小胡萝卜，包菜与甘蓝，还有草莓捣碎了放入秘制酱汁，很好吃的！”
伊拉用木叉戳起一堆蔬菜递给等肉食的艾什，积极地分享她的食物，艾什只能露出尴尬的笑容，摆手拒绝，在她的观念里，自己有钱了为什么不吃肉？自己又不是牲畜，也不是奴隶了。
仔细想想，自己做奴隶的时候也没吃过多少蔬菜就是了，倒是水果偷了不少......
不喝酒也没等到肉食上桌的艾什怪无聊的，她站起身背手，走到柜台那边的高脚凳坐下，去看悬赏和告示上写了什么。
多数悬赏都是一些很无趣的东西，什么谁的牛丢了，需要找回来，雇佣牙医或者请医生去家里看病，招募佣人照顾老人，小型的魔物祸害了菜地之类的。

几张泛黄的告示倒是吸引了艾什的注意力，她把目光落在上面，没有标注日期，有着城市领主盖的火漆印章，是几份通告高精灵们的警示。
洛瑞安附近有班西女妖出没......无趣。
税率降低，但是物价在提升只是暂时的......没劲。
嗯？匪帮游荡，掠夺城外村庄和独居者？
艾什眼中闪过一丝光亮，她伸手摘下钉在墙上关于匪帮的告示，这张告示还很新，精致稍硬，摸起来没有灰尘，很是顺滑，日期写的是11月8日，就在几天前。
开始感兴趣的艾什默读了下去，越仔细看，越觉得几人是走运的。
洛瑞安领主大厅书记官，致西南-“天鹅湾行省”居民：
我们受人喜爱、尊敬，聪慧又仁慈的西林格·史兰泽.克鲁捏特领主大人，深知近几个月天鹅湾行省被无耻、下贱、肮脏的暗精灵匪帮-“夜纱低语会”的骚扰，对此，领主大人顿感愤怒！
领主大人放弃了雇佣贪婪又无能的佣兵们去解决问题，各城市、镇子、村庄民兵将会开始集结，逐步将夜纱低语会的暗精灵赶出天鹅湾行省。
所有来自边境的暗精灵旅客，我们都将进行盘查，包括各个种族，任何知晓夜纱低语会踪迹的居民，外来者，都可以获得一笔来自各城市、镇子、村庄书记官的赏金。
领主和各地守军，不会允许夜纱低语会对居民威胁而漠视！
相信领主大人！相信自己！我们......
后面的字被油污遮住了，艾什看不见，不过也足够艾什能猜测一些事了，看来暗精灵们骚扰高精灵很久了，但是这些夜纱低语会的家伙们是从哪来的呢？跑到高精灵的领地又是做什么？
更何况和暗精灵们战斗时，艾什明显能感觉到对方战技和战意都很高，不像是什么简单的匪帮，可是精灵们都寿命漫长，他们训练几十年，几百年，都在打磨自己。
艾什对付他们不算太轻松，也没觉得自己占到了太多的优势，这些暗精灵曾是士兵？艾什猜不到，可能太多了。
暗精灵怎么样，和自己无关就是了，精灵们死多少艾什都觉得无所谓，不是身后大吃大喝的那个白痴精灵又死一次就好。
content_en:
When almost all races hear the impression of elves, they usually have the impression of longevity, handsomeness, beauty, cleanliness, politeness, etc. People often only see the good side of elves, but Ash sees more than that.
Cumbersome rules and dogmas, pretentious and hypocritical, arrogant and conceited. They uphold nihilistic elegance, but sometimes do worse than the goblins' plots. They pathologically worship nature but destroy them. They are obsessed with self-perception of civilization and have been shackled ever since.
At least most of the elves Ash met gave her this impression. The forest elves brother and sister at the beginning of their journey, the elves from Alek's Patient Wild Deer Search Camp, the wood elves and other elves, plus the dark elf river bandits...
Ash no longer expected to see elves who were truly kind, elegant and could be called elven virtues. Even Ila, who was sitting next to him and gulping apple juice into his mouth, was despised by other high elf travelers.
Who would have thought that there is still discrimination among elves? High elves claim to have a long civilization and are the "one of the origins" of all elves, so they naturally look down on forest elves, swamp elves, wood elves, dark elves, and many other elves.
Ash held his chin and curled his lips, feeling hypocritical of the other high elf travelers. He played with his silver hair disdainfully and looked sideways at the rewards and notices on the hotel counter.
The three languages ​​​​written in the ancient elven language of the high elves, the elven language and the common language of the West Great Road are like the high elves showing off their knowledge.
It was difficult to find a hotel to stay in Lorien. I drove the carriage around the city several times before finding a hotel that could park the carriage and take care of it. The other hotels either had no place to park the carriage or were unwilling to protect the carriage, or did not feed the horses at all.
Fortunately, this hotel called "Greenwood Roots" can do this. The owner is an old high elf couple, which is very strange.
Ash could not even imagine how old the old high elf couple behind the counter would be this year if they lived to an age where their faces were covered with wrinkles and their backs were hunched over.
Their two sons, a grandson and granddaughter maintain this "family hotel", which can be regarded as a family business. The eldest son is in the kitchen making breakfast for Ash and others, while the second son is wiping the carriages of others in the backyard, and then maintaining the horses.
Grandsons and granddaughters who looked to be in their twenties were walking through the hotel lobby, serving food and drinks to travelers. The smiles on their faces did not look like they were fake, giving people a friendly and natural feeling.
They were not bad at etiquette either. They spoke slowly and enunciated clearly. After hearing Ash order a lot of meat, they did not dislike it like Ila did. They happily went to prepare it for Ash. Ash thought it was because he slapped three gold coins on the table...
Barney and the others laughed loudly, causing dissatisfaction among the surrounding high elf travelers. Even if they discriminated against other races, they did not dare to cause trouble. Funea's staff was beside her, and Carson did not look like someone who was easy to bully. Borrick burped and laughed even more happily, as if he was being deliberately rude.
Borrick must have seen the scornful expressions of the high elves staring at Ila. The old bastard was dissatisfied and secretly angered the high elves. But the problem was that Ila didn't even realize that she was being discriminated against. She was eating the elf salad and was almost humming happily.
"The salad made by the same family is still delicious! I miss the salad made by my mother a little! The cherry tomatoes, baby carrots, cabbage, kale, and strawberries are mashed and put into the secret sauce. It's delicious!"
Ila poked a bunch of vegetables with a wooden fork and handed them to Ash, who was waiting for meat, and actively shared her food. Ash could only show an awkward smile and waved her hand to refuse. In her mind, why wouldn't she eat meat when she was rich? He is no longer an animal or a slave.
Think carefully, become your own slaveI didn’t eat many vegetables when I was a slave, but I stole a lot of fruits...
Ash, who didn't drink and didn't wait for the meat to be served, felt bored. She stood up and put her hands behind her back, walked to the high stool at the counter and sat down to see what the reward and notices were.
Most of the bounties are boring things, such as someone's lost cow and needing to find it, hiring a dentist or doctor to see a doctor at home, recruiting servants to take care of the elderly, small monsters harming the vegetable fields, etc.
A few yellowed notices caught Ash's attention, and she focused her gaze on them. They were undated and had the paint seal stamped by the city lord. They were warnings to the high elves.
There's a Bansi banshee hanging around Lorien...boring.
Tax rates are lowered, but rising prices are only temporary... boring.
Um? Bandits roaming around, plundering villages and people living alone outside the city?
A glimmer of light flashed in Ash's eyes, and she reached out and took off the notice about gangsters nailed to the wall. This notice was still new, delicate and slightly hard, dust-free to the touch, and very smooth. The date was November 8th, just a few days ago.
Ashmer became interested and read on. The more he looked at it carefully, the more he felt that several people were lucky.
Clerk of the Lord's Hall of Lorien, to the residents of the southwest - "Swan Bay Province":
Our beloved, respected, intelligent and benevolent Lord Silinger Slanze Crunet is fully aware that the Swan Bay Province has been harassed by the shameless, despicable, and dirty dark elf gang - the "Yisha Whispering Society" in recent months. The Lord is immediately angry about this!
The lord has given up hiring greedy and incompetent mercenaries to solve the problem. Militiamen in cities, towns, and villages will begin to assemble to gradually drive the dark elves of the Nightshade Whispering Society out of the Swan Bay Province.
We will investigate all dark elf travelers from the border, including all races. Any residents or outsiders who know the traces of the Nightshade Whisperers can receive a bounty from the secretaries of various cities, towns, and villages.
The lords and the local garrison will not allow Yesha Whisper to ignore the threat to the residents!
Believe me, Lord! Believe in yourself! We...
The words at the back were obscured by oil, so Ash couldn't see it, but it was enough for Ash to guess something. It seemed that the dark elves had been harassing the high elves for a long time, but where did these guys from the Nightshade Whispering Club come from? What are you doing in the high elf territory?
What's more, when fighting the dark elves, Ash could clearly feel that the other party's combat skills and fighting spirit were very high. They didn't look like a simple gang. However, the elves had long lifespans. They had been training for decades or hundreds of years to hone themselves.
Ash couldn't deal with them too easily, and he didn't feel that he had too many advantages. These dark elves were once soldiers? Ash couldn't guess, maybe too many.
What happened to the dark elves had nothing to do with him. Ash didn't care how many elves died, as long as the idiot elf behind him who was eating and drinking died again.
